program='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    cw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    ccw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half = [row[:] + cw[i] for i, row in enumerate(grid)]
    half.extend(ccw[i] + grid[n - 1 - i][::-1] for i in range(n))
    return half
'''
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
